mapper.select: SELECT t1.code id, CASE WHEN t1.businessunit = '0' THEN concat(t1.name, '-业务单元') WHEN t1.businessunit = 1 THEN concat(t1.name, '-部门') ELSE t1.name END AS name, t2.code parent_id, TO_NUMBER(t1.businessunit) sort, to_char(t1.code) code FROM ( SELECT code, name, pk_org, decode(nvl(pk_fatherorg, '~'), '~', pk_corp, pk_fatherorg) pk_fatherorg, '0' businessunit FROM nc65.org_orgs WHERE dr = 0 AND isbusinessunit = 'Y' AND pk_group = '0001E1100000000007QU' AND islastversion = 'Y' AND ( enablestate = 1 OR enablestate = 2 ) UNION SELECT code, name, pk_dept pk_org, decode(pk_fatherorg, '~', pk_org, pk_fatherorg) pk_fatherorg, '1' businessunit FROM nc65.org_dept WHERE ( enablestate = 1 OR enablestate = 2 ) AND dr = 0 ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT code, name, pk_org, decode(nvl(pk_fatherorg, '~'), '~', pk_corp, pk_fatherorg) pk_fatherorg FROM nc65.org_orgs WHERE dr = 0 AND isbusinessunit = 'Y' AND pk_group = '0001E1100000000007QU' AND islastversion = 'Y' AND ( enablestate = 1 OR enablestate = 2 ) UNION SELECT code, name, pk_dept pk_org, decode(pk_fatherorg, '~', pk_org, pk_fatherorg) pk_fatherorg FROM nc65.org_dept WHERE ( enablestate = 1 OR enablestate = 2 ) AND dr = 0 ) t2 ON t2.pk_org = t1.pk_fatherorg

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT id, name, parent_id parentId FROM system_dept WHERE parent_id = '103' and status = 0 and name LIKE '%业务单元%' UNION ALL SELECT system_dept.id, system_dept.name, system_dept.parent_id parentId FROM system_dept INNER JOIN descendants ON system_dept.parent_id = descendants.id WHERE system_dept.name LIKE '%业务单元%' and status = 0 ) SELECT * FROM descendants
